The company raised two rounds of private equity in 2021 and 2022 respectively. In October 2021, the company started its new manufacturing plant in [[Bhiwadi]], [[Rajasthan]].{{cite web |last1=Dhanjal |first1=Swaraj Singh |title=AC maker EPACK to raise ₹160 crore from ICICI Ventures |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/ac-maker-epack-to-raise-160-crore-from-icici-ventures-11633545040252.html |website=[[Mint (newspaper)]] |language=en |date=7 October 2021}} In to set up ₹200-crore unit in Sri City of Andhra Pradesh |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/epack-outsourced-design-manufacturer-of-acs-to-set-up-200-crore-unit-in-sri-city-of-andhra-pradesh/article66111004.ece |website=[[The Hindu]] |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/epack-durable-to-debut-today-what-you-need-to-know-101706586820015.html |website=Hindustan Times |language=en-us |date=30 January 2024}}{{cite web September 2024, EPACK partnered with [[Symphony Limited]] to manufacture air coolers as OEMs.{{cite web |last1=Nandan |first1=Navneeta |title=Epack Durable partners with Symphony to manufacture air coolers in growing Indian market |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/durables/epack-durable-partners-with-symphony-to-manufacture-air-coolers-in-growing-indian-market/articleshow/113059924.cms |website=[[The Economic Times]] |date=4 September 2024}} This was followed by another partnership with [[Hisense|Hisense Singapore]] for manufacturing of air conditioner and home appliances for |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/epack-durable-inks-pact-with-hisense-124102200108_1.html |website=Business Standard}} In the same month, the company also partnered extract:
EPACK DURABLE is an Indian OEM and ODM manufacturer of living appliances. The company specializes in design and manufacturing of large domestic appliances such as air conditioners, washing machines, air coolers, small kitchen appliances and components. It is headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh.
EPACK Durable is a publicly listed company on National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) as of 30 January 2024.
